correctness.rationale: For kappa<=0 the strict cone forces ds/dt<0. For kappa>0 d=0 produces the sole central point; d!=0 requires s=(1+H)/(2mu), and substitution gives d²/s²=(kappa-kappa_c)/(kappa+4mu), yielding exactly two additional strict-cone zeros iff kappa>kappa_c. Central Jacobian eigenvalues kappa/2 and (1+H)(kappa-kappa_c)/(2(1-H)); off-axis determinant is negative. Formal expansion at threshold independently gives center manifold u=(4mu/((1-H)(1+H))) d²+O(d⁴), and cubic reduced coefficient -16mu³/((1-H)(1+H)²), nonzero opposite sign to unfolding. Thus an exact supercritical pitchfork on the center direction; the transverse direction is unstable.
residual_risks: Local strict-sliding equilibria only; does not classify all positive-kappa global dynamics or dynamics through fold/two-fold boundaries.
